name: Authentication & Authorization Security
purpose: Audit and enforce robust authentication, session management, and RBAC/ABAC models.
inputs: Identity flows, client types, federation providers, and session/token architecture
Password, MFA, recovery, authorization, and account-lockout policies
Threat model, abuse cases, and compliance and retention requirements
outputs: Authentication and authorization findings mapped to affected flows
Corrected credential, token, session, MFA, and recovery controls
Abuse, replay, revocation, and authorization test evidence
stop_conditions: No unresolved critical or high authentication, session, MFA, or authorization finding remains
Refresh replay, account takeover, and privilege-escalation tests pass
Token budget exhausted or identity-policy authority is unavailable
